reason: A DSH interface plugin that adds a side-chat panel for asking focused questions about selected message text while keeping the main conversation visible; it also supports annotated selections and uses a forked session that can perform real shared-workspace tool actions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供侧边聊天面板，可针对选中的消息文本进行独立追问、添加批注并将内容带回主对话。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness side-chat panel for focused questions about selected message text, annotated passages, and independent follow-up sessions alongside the main conversation.

capabilities: Fork a DSH session from the selected message
Add annotated passages to the main composer
Choose a model and reasoning effort for Side Chat
Perform file changes, commands, and other tool actions in the shared workspace
